title: Upload writability fix
summary: Reports a socket as writable when the kernel would accept a send, as Windows does. Stock Wine waits for poll(), which holds a single upload stream to about 140 KB/s. Filed as WineHQ bug 59893 and submitted upstream.
warning: Off, uploads run at stock Wine speed.

title: FD_WRITE re-arm
summary: Lets a socket report FD_WRITE again after a poll finds it full, so upload threads stop waiting out timeouts. Measured at about three times the total upload rate on a live backup.
warning: Windows does not do this. It is a workaround until Wine's socket rework lands, and it needs the upload writability fix.

title: Service token (LocalSystem)
summary: Gives services the LocalSystem group and an enabled SeDebugPrivilege, as on Windows. Client 10.0.3.1075 and later needs it: without it every backup pass loses its four-hour lock.
warning: Off, the client must stay on 10.0.1.1069, and the container pins it unless you set BACKBLAZE_VERSION.

title: OFD file locks
summary: Uses open file description locks, so wineserver can close a file the client closed. Without it the client's database leaks descriptors until nothing in the prefix can open a file (issue #13).
warning: Off, the container restarts the service before the leak reaches Wine's open-file limit.

title: Case-sensitivity cache
summary: Decides once per device whether names are case sensitive, instead of asking the file system after every failed lookup. On Unraid user shares that check was half a scan's time.
warning: Changes how ciopfs is recognised: by mount type rather than a .ciopfs file.

title: Datasets as folders
summary: Shows ZFS datasets and other mount points inside a drive as plain folders, so the client backs them up. Set per drive in the Datasets as folders panel or with MOUNTPOINTS_AS_DIRS.
warning: Windows does not do this. Datasets already backed up under their own letter upload again, and a drive mapped inside another is backed up twice.
